_about: FluxCore ruleset v1. Every generation parameter lives here; no generation constant appears in a .cpp file. Derived artifacts record the FNV-1a hash of this file's raw bytes, so any edit -- including whitespace -- invalidates them on purpose. Keys beginning with '_' are comments and are ignored by the loader.
_letterWeights: Spec 2.4 item 1, FITTED rather than assumed. Inverse-fitted against the observed letter marginal of 9,034 real ranked boards (data/ranked/fitted_distribution.json): the base distribution which, pushed through tier draw, seeding and best-of-N as in ruleset v1, reproduces the observed post-selection marginal. Everything else is identical to ruleset_v1.json.
_scoreTable: Spec 2.2, confirmed. 3/4/5/6 are given; n >= 7 is 1400 + 400(n-6), written out to length 25 because a 5x5 board can in principle hold a 25-letter path.
_seeding: Spec 2.3: 50% of boards carry a seed, drawn and placed independently per candidate. extraSeedCount/allowSeedOverlap are the LetterCounter overlap mode, which produces denser clusters than the spec's single-seed description; off by default because the spec describes one seed, and turning them on changes the board distribution.
_cheapScoring: Truncated candidate scoring with an early exit (spec 5.3). Disabled by default: it is only safe to turn on where the measured winner-agreement rate against full solving is high enough that it cannot move the board distribution. marginPerMille is how far under the leader a candidate's projected total must fall before it is dropped; larger is more conservative. These values were measured with tools/genbench over 5,220 boards: 99.90% winner agreement at 1.48x. minStartCells 4 buys 1.94x but drops agreement to 97.97%, which is not safe.
_grids: Spec 2.3. Grid split 60/40, tiers Spam 20 / Good Casual 50 / Casual 30, candidate counts as published. Where min != max, N is drawn uniformly per board. Seed lengths are 8-11 on 4x4 and 9-13 on 5x5, with the longest (11 and 13) restricted to Spam; the spec gives no distribution over the remaining lengths, so uniform weights are provisional.
